content.short: Kyoko is a cross-chain platform enabling GameFi NFT lending for players and guilds.
content.description: Kyoko is a cross-chain platform for GameFi NFT lending that serves both players and guilds. It enables P2P NFT lending, cross-chain lending, and guild-to-guild lending, helping users expand their gaming assets and venture into play-to-earn titles. Supporting Ethereum, Solana, Base, Arbitrum, and Avalanche, Kyoko lowers the barriers to entry across multiple ecosystems, making it easier to access and leverage NFT assets for both individual players and gaming communities.
